question: Does a candidate intervention corpus contain enough matched state-action-lag contrast to test state-specific recovery prediction?
outcome_target: RECOVERED versus FAILED under one frozen recovery-target hash
anti_rescue: Changing the lags, thresholds, recovery target, risk buckets, actions, or outcome labels after an audit requires a new experiment ID.
next_if_success: Run a context-held-out tournament: action-plus-delay versus state-plus-action-plus-delay. Do not train a capacity selector yet.
next_if_failure: Repair the intervention substrate or stop. Do not compensate with a more elaborate model.
